name: opentronsagent
description: Simulate Opentrons Flex protocols with the opentrons package and look up the labware definitions it ships, plus Opentrons shared data on GitHub. Biorouter asks before each simulation, which runs the protocol's Python. No key needed.

env_vars.description: Optional folder for the simulator's configuration and temporary custom labware. Default: a folder beside Biorouter's data.

skills.name: opentrons-lab-automation
skills.description: How to call OpentronsAgent's tools: simulate Opentrons Flex protocols, look up labware definitions, and read Opentrons shared data on GitHub.
